focus.title: 美国升级对华半导体设备出口管制，中国企业需加速供应链合规调整
focus.summary: 2026年8月初，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）宣布进一步收紧对华半导体制造设备出口许可政策，将部分成熟制程设备纳入管制范围，并强化最终用户审查。此举将影响中国晶圆厂及设备采购方，企业需重新评估供应链风险，及时申请许可或调整采购策略。建议出海企业密切关注BIS实体清单更新，并建立动态合规机制，确保贸易合规。
focus.source: 来源：美国商务部工业与安全局公告 · 2026.08.05
focus.title_en: US Tightens Export Controls on Semiconductor Equipment to China, Urging Supply Chain Compliance Adjustments
focus.summary_en: In early August 2026, the US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) announced further restrictions on export licenses for semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China, expanding controls to some mature-node tools and strengthening end-user reviews. This move will impact Chinese wafer fabs and equipment buyers, requiring them to reassess supply chain risks, apply for licenses promptly, or adjust procurement strategies. Companies going global are advised to closely monitor BIS entity list updates and establish dynamic compliance mechanisms to ensure trade compliance.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：跨境股权回购争议中，情势变更原则的适用边界
case.summary: 近期，新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）就一起中资企业跨境股权回购纠纷作出裁决。因目标公司所在国政策突变，回购条件未能成就，一方主张情势变更免责，但仲裁庭认为，商业风险应由当事人自行承担，合同未约定不可抗力条款，故驳回该抗辩。此案提示中国企业，在跨境投资中应明确约定不可抗力及情势变更条款，并留存政策变化证据，以降低履约风险。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心案例摘要 · 2026.07
case.title_en: SIAC Ruling Clarifies Scope of Changed Circumstances in Cross-Border Share Buyback Disputes
case.summary_en: In a recent Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) ruling concerning a cross-border share buyback dispute involving Chinese investors, the tribunal rejected a party's defense based on changed circumstances, holding that commercial risks should be borne by the parties and that the contract lacked a force majeure clause. The case underscores the importance for Chinese enterprises to explicitly stipulate force majeure and hardship clauses in cross-border investment contracts and to preserve evidence of policy changes to mitigate performance risks.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，企业需建立数据出境合规清单
policy.summary: 2026年7月，广东省网信办发布《粤港澳大湾区个人信息跨境流动便利化措施（试行）》，在自贸区范围内简化个人信息出境安全评估流程，但要求企业建立数据出境合规清单并备案。该政策旨在促进大湾区数据要素流通，同时强化监管。企业应梳理数据出境场景，开展个人信息保护影响评估，并利用便利化通道，降低合规成本。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.07
policy.title_en: New Rules on Cross-Border Data Flows in the Greater Bay Area Take Effect, Requiring Compliance Inventories
policy.summary_en: In July 2026, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province issued the 'Measures for Facilitating Cross-Border Personal Information Flows in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Trial)', which simplify the security assessment process for personal information exports within free trade zones, but require enterprises to establish and file compliance inventories for data exports. The policy aims to promote data flow in the GBA while strengthening supervision. Companies should map data export scenarios, conduct personal information protection impact assessments, and leverage the facilitated channels to reduce compliance costs.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · 2026.07

analysis.title: 欧盟《外国补贴条例》执法趋严，中企投标欧盟公共采购需提前自我评估
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：近期欧盟委员会依据《外国补贴条例》对多起中资企业参与的公共采购项目启动深入调查，重点审查补贴是否扭曲内部市场。建议中国企业在参与欧盟公共采购或收购欧盟企业前，主动进行补贴申报和内部合规审查，评估可能被认定为外国补贴的政府支持措施，并准备抗辩材料，以降低交易受阻风险。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球研究团队 · 2026.08.05
analysis.title_en: EU's Foreign Subsidies Regulation Enforcement Intensifies: Chinese Firms Need Pre-Bid Self-Assessment
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The European Commission has recently launched in-depth investigations into several public procurement projects involving Chinese companies under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation, focusing on whether subsidies distort the internal market. It is advisable for Chinese enterprises to proactively conduct subsidy notifications and internal compliance reviews before bidding on EU public procurement or acquiring EU targets, assess government support measures that could be deemed foreign subsidies, and prepare defense materials to reduce the risk of transaction disruption.
